title: Implement dynamic sample data and regression tests
goal: Make new-database sample dates relative to today and add completion and compatibility regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: Fresh sample database includes meaningful past, current, and future task dates
Completion status and edit preservation have automated regression coverage
All existing and new npm tests pass without schema or export changes

release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the local task commit before integration
release_controls.observation_metrics: validation results, changed paths, browser evidence, and governance review
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope drift, baseline mismatch, failing validation, or unresolved reviewer finding
